crossRefs.note: Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly…
Have you utterly rejected Judah? Has your soul loathed Zion? Why have you struck us, and there is no healing for us? We…
Then Yahweh said to me, “Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind would not turn toward this people. Cast…
I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.
Then I said, “I will not feed you. That which dies, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and…

translations.web: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.
translations.bsb: So because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to vomit you out of My mouth!
translations.kjv: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.
translations.asv: So because thou art lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will spew thee out of my mouth.
